title: Gifts of The Holy Spirit
paragraphs: This is the essence of healing, really, just God's love touching people. It manifests itself in different ways. One way it manifests is by speaking in tongues. But this is not the only way it manifests. So please don't get attached to tongues alone. Tongues are a very important part of your expression in the Holy Spirit. In fact, it is a very essential part of your personal development. It is important for your spiritual development. It is important to connect with God. It is an intercessionary duty.

It is important to pray for needs you do not understand. It's important. Therefore, you must serve with tongues. And I believe that everyone in this room will do that sooner or later. Amen. Even if you don't want to. On Judgment Day, we will all start speaking in tongues anyway. We will be extremely excited. But the tongues are for the present. Not for the sky. It's for the present. We need to serve the Lord and build ourselves up in the Lord according to 1 Corinthians chapter 14.

But there are many ways in which the Holy Spirit manifests himself. Some of them are included in what we will talk about today. We will address each one separately over the next few weeks. The reason for discussing them separately is that people don't know what they are or when to experience them. Sometimes the Lord gives you a gift. He gives you a talent and you sit in the meeting wondering what is happening. What is this? And you do not realize that it is a gift from God to serve in the flesh.

And so you sit and miss a beautiful opportunity to serve in the body of Christ. God will not be angry with you if you do not do that. The thing is, you lack the knowledge, and he just hopes that you will listen in the next few weeks so that you can learn. Good? And so you will be active in the body of Christ and ready to be used by Him to serve the whole body together. Now, we have also talked about emotion. People get excited and call it the Holy Spirit.

The Holy Spirit is not an emotion, and the Holy Spirit is not emotional, but He may affect your feelings. So when you are upset, don't blame the Holy Spirit. Blame your feelings. Did you understand? The Holy Spirit is a power, an absolute power, and when power is unleashed, something is bound to be affected, and our emotions seem to be the most logical thing to be affected. When there is strength in our bodies, and when there is joy or freedom, our feelings are affected by these things.

Therefore, when many people experience this power, they do not know what to do. Because they don't know how to release them, they seem to be acting crazy. They run back and forth in churches, shouting, kicking pews, hitting people on the head, and other useless things. I call it useless because it really is. It does me no good to hit me on the head and then blame the Holy Spirit. It also doesn't help me to shout in church while everyone is trying to listen to the preacher. correct. This is pointless.

It is also pointless to hold a private party in the middle of the seats while people are trying to worship God and you are distracting them. This is pointless. But many people blame it on the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit is blamed for all kinds of things. I tell you that the Bible says that the Holy Spirit is a spirit of order and propriety. You will find that in today's Bible. He is in perfect shape. He does things systematically. He does things with elegance. do you understand?

He is top-notch and does nothing to confuse anyone. He is not a god of confusion. Therefore, everything the Holy Spirit does is done in an orderly and proper manner. Amen. I love that. This is our method in this service because we follow his example completely. Glorify the Lord. We do things with propriety and order. If you don't want to do things politely, go somewhere where they don't do them politely. You are free to do that, but we will do things the way God's word says. We agreed?

Therefore, emotions should not replace the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit influences our emotions, but we control our emotions. The Bible says that the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets. This means that the Holy Spirit is moving within you. And you can control it. You can close your mouth until it's time to speak. If you feel like running back and forth, you can sit down. The Bible says if you want to prophesy and someone else is speaking, shut your mouth until they finish.

This is what the Bible says. In other words, the Holy Spirit does not possess you. Have you heard that before? Oh, I had the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit does not possess you. You own it. This is correct. I couldn't control myself. Some people say, "Oh, yes, you can. " Obedience is better than sacrifice. Amen. I've heard that before. Do you know what sacrifice means? Worship of God. God cares more about your obedience to Him than He cares about your worship of Him.

Some people prefer to come to church, sing in the choir, and do this and that for God, but they will not obey Him. Some people are so active for God that they don't even know Him. The Holy Spirit is within us and we must obey Him. We do not obey our feelings or emotions. We obey Him. One of the powerful words he said was that he is the Comforter. The comforter does not vandalize churches, break pews, or disturb or confuse people. The comforter calms people. Amen. Good.

We also mentioned that when the Holy Spirit comes and unleashes his energy, it must be released. It's like dynamite. The word Jesus used in Acts 1:8 to describe the power of the Holy Spirit is "Dunamis," which means explosive enabling power, a power like dynamite. When dynamite explodes, something moves. Dynamite is powerful. The church is a dynamic force on earth. History tells us that the church has always been a church of action.

If you read the Bible, everything the disciples preached is what they did, because that is what Jesus intended for his church. Jesus was the greatest example of that. We also talked a little about tongues. One of the primary expressions of the Holy Spirit is tongues. He is not the only one, but he is usually the first because the tongue is the easiest thing for God to reach. Your tongue is the biggest problem in your life. Therefore, the first thing God would like to touch is your tongue.

As you know, Jacob says that the tongue can destroy your entire body and everyone around you. Many of us have seen that. Thus, when you begin to experience baptism by the Holy Spirit, one of the ways He expresses Himself is by giving you words that you can speak with your mouth. Another point we mentioned is that speaking in tongues is not something the Holy Spirit does himself. It's something you do after he puts the words into your soul. Do you understand that?

Some people expect the Holy Spirit to speak on their behalf. He does n't do that. Wherever you find in the Bible that people spoke in tongues, it always says: "And they spoke." Even when they were filled with the Holy Spirit on the day of Pentecost, he says that they spoke as the Spirit gave them to speak. The spirit did not give them the same words. The Spirit gave them the words. Some of us sit and wait for something to happen to our tongues. It doesn't happen to your tongue.

It happens to your soul, to your inner being. It's also very much about trust. If you believe that God does not lie, then when you ask Him a question, He will answer you. Give me baptism in the Holy Spirit. Fill me with the Spirit. Thank you, Lord, in Jesus' name. I accept the Holy Spirit. Now, Lord, I believe every word you have said to me. So, I will begin speaking in tongues, and hear, O God, if you forsake me, we shall see. But some people don't even do that. They are just sitting.

They have no faith in the word of God. They sit and wait for him to do it. That's why they haven't done it yet. You must begin by progressing in faith just as you do in salvation. She says, "Oh God, I'm going to start speaking in tongues now." What happens is similar to turning on a water tap. It begins with a few drops and then suddenly, a beautiful river of heavenly language flows. Now, that's one way of expressing this.

What I want to talk about is that people are afraid to receive something else instead of the Holy Spirit. Have you ever heard people say: How do I know that I am receiving the Holy Spirit? What if I received a demonic spirit? I've been in that situation before. Jesus spoke about this one day, and he was very honest with people. He said, “ You know how to give good gifts to your children. When they ask you for bread, do not give them a stone. When they ask for a fish, do not give them a snake.”

He says, " Now, how much more will my Father give you the Holy Spirit when you ask him for it?" The word "serpent" in this passage from the book is the same word used in Mark when the Lord was talking about demons. Remember that he also mentioned in Luke his saying: “I will give you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy.” The word "snake" is a Greek expression meaning demons. Jesus has always described Satan as either a snake, a scorpion, or an evil spirit.

So when he was talking about snakes in relation to receiving the Holy Spirit, he said that you do n't give people a snake. He said, "Do you think God would give you one if you asked Him for the Holy Spirit?" He says, "No." He says, "How much more will the Lord give you the Holy Spirit if you ask Him for it?" So you are asking God for the Holy Spirit. God does not have a snake to give you. Don't keep bringing life. You are asking Him to fill you with the Holy Spirit. Then He will fill you with the Holy Spirit.

This is the only soul he has. The Holy Spirit, because He is holy. So you can be reassured and confident in the fact that if you ask God for the Holy Spirit, this is the Spirit you will receive. God cannot give you a demon. God does not have demons to give. Do you understand that? They are not from his family. They do not belong to it. They rebelled. May God give us good gifts. Every good gift comes from above, and demons are not good gifts. Therefore, if it is not a good gift, God does not give it.

Now if you ask him for the Holy Spirit, he will give it to you. Good. Now let's talk about these gifts. Let us turn to 1 Corinthians, chapter twelve. Now, regarding spiritual gifts, the first verse: “I do not want you to be ignorant, brothers.” This is possible. You see, the word "brothers" means that these people are Christians. Good? But the word “ignorant” means that they did not receive any education. So it is possible to be a Christian but ignorant. The word “tajahlu” means ignorant or stupid. Or uneducated.

Now, many Christians hate to have you tell them that to their faces. I have been a Christian for 50 years. You can't teach me anything. I know everything. Thank God. That's all. And they mean it too. They will argue with you to your face. You are a little boy. I just got here. You can barely zip up your pants. Do you want to tell me about Jesus? Who do you think you are? Paul says, " Yes, you are brothers. Well, you are ignorant brothers.

What I have discovered is that you can only lead people as far as you have come." Can you say that with me? You can only lead people to the extent that you yourself have reached. If you remember that, you will be a great leader because you will always realize that you have to keep moving forward. Some people never got further than their leaders because the leaders never went anywhere. What can I teach you? That's all I know. I think this is one of the sad things about our situation in this country.

There are many leaders who have not taken the time, effort, or even patience to delve into the matters of God sufficiently to lead those who follow them. And so we see people going around in circles every week, just going around in circles. Paul was a good man. Paul says: I do not want you to be ignorant. In other words, I know a little more than you do. So come and walk with me. I know some people who simply love their leaders, even if the leaders don't know anything, they just love them. I can follow him.

He is the best man I have ever known. They stay with that person for 50 years and know only what he knows. And guess what he knows? Then they wonder why they do not grow, flourish and multiply in the ways of God. We are not in competition. This is not a competition. This is a matter of survival. The Bible says: “ Work out your salvation with fear and trembling.” God is not going to come to you and say, "How long have you been with the Catholic Church?" Does he care about that?

He is interested in how much you resemble Jesus. This is what he will ask you about. How much of Jesus is in you? How much do I mean to you? Some people are preoccupied with competition. You know, we are this church and we are that church. My preacher did this and my preacher did that. I don't want anyone to boast about me. Boast about the word of God. Boast about the word of God. They boasted about Jesus. I am only giving you what He gave me.

And I tell you, if you continue to follow me, it makes it more difficult for me because I have to keep moving forward. As you can see, you would know better than I would if I didn't do that. I will continue talking so that I can keep up with all of you. What? We must grow together and learn God's word together. Paul says: “Regarding spiritual gifts, brothers and sisters, I do not want you to be ignorant.” There are many types of talents, but he says they were unaware of these particular talents.

As we know, this is a common occurrence in our situation here in this city as well. But thank God that He is now addressing this issue. You know that you were nations led astray by mute idols, just as you were led. Therefore, let me tell you that no one who speaks by the Spirit of God will say, "Jesus is cursed," nor will anyone be able to say, " Jesus is Lord." And that no one can say that Jesus is Lord except by the Holy Spirit. This entire verse says just this.

No one can say that Jesus is Lord and truly mean it unless the Holy Spirit is in him. In other words, there are many religious people who stand up and say good things, but he says that much of what they say is not from the Holy Spirit. They are just talking nonsense and empty words. Religious institutions are full of hypocrites. The hypocrite is simply what we just read in verse three. A person says that Jesus is my Lord, but he lives like the devil.

The Bible says that no one can truly say that unless the Holy Spirit says it through them, because the Holy Spirit makes Jesus Lord in our lives. Okay, look at verse four. There are different kinds of talents, but the spirit is one. The word " types," write this down, simply means different. The Holy Spirit baptizes us and then releases that baptism into gifts. Talents are diverse; there are many different types. Therefore, we have a diversity of talents, but a unity of purpose. Please note that.

We have a diversity of talents, but a unity of purpose. Regardless of what is done in this company, the purpose must be one. It is the glorification of God and the building up of the body. One purpose. No matter how many ways the Holy Spirit manifests himself, he has one idea in his mind: to glorify Jesus. Not to boast and say, "I speak in tongues, and I have better talents than you." Not to say, "Hey kid, you really danced in church today."

Not to say, " Hey kid, I had a blast in that corner dancing and jumping around." No, no, no. He has one goal in mind. Whatever he does, the same Spirit manifests itself in many ways, but for one purpose: to glorify Jesus. Let us look here at verse seven. Rather, it is verse six. There are different kinds of work, but it is God himself who works all in all. Please take note of this. It is God himself who works all in all. It is God himself who does everything. This is the first point.

This means that all the gifts of the Spirit are made by God. Then he does it to everyone. It works in everyone. But, brother Miles, why didn't I predict it? Why don't I do what others do? Why do n't I receive from the Lord? God is working within you. That is why the first verse was written in that chapter. You may not realize that it works. We are here to help you understand the consciousness of the soul so that you become sensitive and know when God is working in you.

Sometimes you have to step forward and rely on pure faith. Pure faith, and this is a good faith. Also underline the word "works". And now we have the word "services" in verse five. This means distribution. The Holy Spirit distributes them. He has different talents that he distributes. But the next verse says "works". This means that when he distributes them, they may appear differently to each person. Ten talents could be distributed here in this company today among these people.

But the way it will appear in you may be different from the way it appears in you. The work may be different. The Lord may give a prophecy to three people, and each of them may perform it in a different way. One person might sing it, another might perform it in tongues, and a third might perform it in English. But it is the same prophecy, a distributed prophecy, but the actions are different. Do you understand what he is saying? So don't expect to do it the way someone else does it, because that's their way.

Do it the way God created you naturally, and let it flow naturally from you. Some people come to a meeting, and I've heard people do this a lot. They get up and adopt their prophetic voice, "Thus says the Lord," and become affected, and you know that this is not their real voice, man. The Lord has something to tell us through you. Tell us and tell us as a part of the body. You don't have to impress us. Amen. Amen. Amen. So, you don't need to come up here and act all spiritual.

Just come and say: "Thank God, the Lord has given me the word of the day and I feel in my heart that this is what the Lord wants us to know." Then simply share it. Sometimes the Lord may give you just a biblical verse. That is one of the processes of the soul. Sometimes the Lord may bring you to the meeting, and on your way here, something may ignite within you, perhaps just one word, perhaps a word like "life".

You may not realize that the Holy Spirit is trying to tell you to tell the body that they are full of life. When you come here, you don't have to get too spiritual about it. The Holy Spirit is so natural that it transcends nature. It works through us in different ways, so don't try to be like anyone else. Do you understand what I'm saying? If he moves in Patricia, Patricia is Patricia and he will reveal himself through her in the manner of her character, but she will still be the word of God.

He says that it is the one spirit that works. So we don't need to impress anyone by trying to be like everyone else. Just be yourself in spirit. Let's look at verse seven. But to each one it is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the benefit. Please underline the phrase " for the benefit". This simply means—write it down—that it will benefit or be of use to the entire church. Anything God does is for the benefit of everyone in the company. Showcasing these talents is for the benefit of all.

Now, Paul continues from here to list the nine gifts. Let's deal with this public interest for a few minutes. Okay. I am very happy that you are listening to me. I can feel you listening because we need to know the truth here. The Bible says that all these are manifestations of the Spirit. Now, "showing" means either that you can see something or hear something. Demonstration means a tangible experience. It means that God is revealing himself and you can see him now.

Whether it is in prophecy, or tongues, or word of knowledge, or healing, or miracle, whatever it may be, you can see it. He says, "Now, whatever God gives, whatever talent comes, it is not to be boasted about." Rather, it is for everyone to benefit from it. Have you ever heard people say this? Oh, well, I am Prophet So-and- so. A great thing. Look, they're showing off. The Bible says that any talent you have is not truly yours. It was written there. It was given to you for the sake of others, not for your own sake.

If I have a talent for teaching, it's not for me. I cannot sit in front of the mirror to teach myself. If you have the gift of healing, you do not need to be healed. There is another person who is sick. If the Lord moves you through faith in your heart to lay your hand on someone, it is because someone needs it. Everything the soul shows is for the sake of others. So some people think, you know, boy, you made a good prophecy today. Wow, I must have become spiritual. Oh, no, you're not. You need help now.

You are in real trouble now. Because what you got was not yours. It was for everyone, to benefit everyone. Here's another problem we often face. People experience the manifestation of the Holy Spirit and think they are better than others. Is n't this interesting? They even make people change their surnames, you know? I will visit so-and-so the prophetess. What makes it special? Oh man. She is lucky that the Lord is using her, and she should be humble and praise the Lord.

As you know, the Bible says: “Do not let anyone call you Master, Teacher, or Rabbi.” Jesus said that. He knew what he was talking about. He says: "Do not walk around in synagogues and on the streets showing yourself as you are not. " He said, "Because you did not choose me." Look how clever Jesus is. Do n't get carried away by this now. You did not choose me. I chose you. He says, "So don't let anyone call you 'Sir, Sir.'" He said that to his disciples. I mean the big eleven, you know, he told them.

Don't let anyone call you that. Oh, and people love to be called all sorts of names. I hate to mention some of them because you might feel uncomfortable. I mean, some people have very long nicknames. Some even call them the righteous. You don't have to call them righteous. You're a bar. God, Jesus. Jesus made everyone righteous through his blood. When you come to Jesus, you become righteous. You don't have to call anyone at the bar. I am a bar. We are all saints. This one is a saint, and that one is a saint.

Where did we get this from? You read the Bible in all its books. Remember that we write this, “ Send this letter to the saints in Corinth, the saints in Ephesus, the saints in Galatia, the saints in Rome, the saints.” Why? Every believer is a saint. The word saint simply means holy. That's all. We are all sanctified by the blood of Jesus. Amen. Don't be swayed by people who praise others, man. Everything you have is for everyone, so it's best to give it away.

Now, this leads us to another principle, a principle we need to pay attention to. If it is beneficial to everyone, then everyone here has something to offer me. Everyone here has something to offer me. Everyone here has something to offer the person sitting next to them. I think our sister shared with us this morning about talents. Sometimes the gifts of the Holy Spirit work in you, so you possess the Holy Spirit.

There is no way you can imagine how great it would be if, instead of running up to me in the middle of the morning while I was half awake trying to spend some time with my wife, you called me and said, "But the bus. I have a bus." Would n't it be wonderful to be able to call someone right next to you and say, "Sister, let's pray together about this matter." I believe the spirit works through everyone. It benefits everyone. You know, there are times when I really want to spend time with my family.

And wow, it's hard sometimes, you know, and I understand that because people really believe in the ministry, and their belief isn't strong enough to stand on its own. Therefore, they want someone through whom they believe their prayers will be answered. And I believe in what I pray for. I believe that when I pray, God performs miracles. But I want you to know today that you are just as important as I am. We are not different. God loves you just as much as He loves me.

And his talents work in you just as they work in me. So we will learn how to develop it. Good? Make it work and make it active so that you and I can work together as an army and a force that can change everything we face. We will either destroy it or change it, whatever comes against us. Therefore, the goal is to benefit everyone; it was given for the benefit of everyone. Now Paul goes on to name these gifts, and what we will cover today are the three categories of these gifts. Let's look at verse eight.

For to one is given through the Spirit the words of wisdom. And to another the word of knowledge according to the one Spirit. And another has faith in the one Spirit. And to others gifts of healing by the one Spirit. To another works of miracles, to another prophecy, to another discernment of spirits, to another various kinds of tongues, to another interpretation of tongues. But don't let your emotions get the better of you now.

But all these things are done by the same one Spirit, distributing to each one individually as He wills. The Bible says, "Do not be swept away." Now, you lay your hand on someone and they are healed. Don't get carried away by that. Isn't that so? You say: "I cured so-and-so and so-and-so." You haven't healed anyone. The Bible says in verse 11: “But all these things are done by the same one Spirit.” Amen. He is the one who did the work. This is correct.

You know, I have witnessed some amazing healings, and the word "amazing" isn't even accurate because it's a bad word. The word "fantastic" is derived from the word " fantasy," and healings are not fantasies. I have personally experienced some amazing cases of recovery. I have seen things that I may never share with people. I know a woman, a young girl, who was unable to have children. They had to perform surgery on her internal organs and uterus, and she was unable to conceive. Oh dear, she longed for children.

They removed something, you understand, so there was no way out. She came to the prayer line, and I prayed for her. I asked her, "What's the problem?" She said, "It's a personal matter." So I said to her, " Okay, I will pray for you." While I was praying for her, the Lord told me what it was. I got what you call a "word of science". Look, it's written right here. The spirit told me that this is the problem. She has a problem with her uterus, and she cannot conceive.

So I said to her, "You want to have a baby, do n't you?" She said, "Yes." I prayed for her, and laid my hand on her, and she fell completely unconscious by the power of the spirit. It is the power of God. This actually happened in Europe. The Lord told me, "Don't worry about it." "She's fine." "I am now healed." That was a tremendous cure, because after nine months, I mean, you know, they must have worked on it that night. I don't know.

But nine months later, my wife and I received a letter; she had given birth to a child, a beautiful boy. We returned in... in fact, I returned alone last Christmas. Man, I held the little baby in my arms and knew and said, "This is a miracle." A child was born from a uterus that doctors had already removed. And all other kinds of things. This is a miracle. This is more than just healing. This is a miracle. Healing is when God fixes something. A miracle is when something is created that did not exist before.

Now, something like this, you know, you might think I'm going to write a book about it and brag about it and everything. No, no, man. After that, another person was cured of cancer. Then I saw one eye open. She doesn't know which one to boast about. So you simply aren't showing off. She says that God is at work. This is God's work, and God is the one who receives the glory. Because it works, that's why we need to stop worrying so much about whether they will recover or not. We pray for them.

It is not your job to heal them. Some of us get scared when people ask us to go to the hospital. Pray for the sick. The first thing we think about is what if I fail? You won't even succeed. Success is not in your hands. God is the one who does the work. Your job is to go and put your hands on the patients. So don't worry too much about what happens after you get your hands on them. Your work is finished. Do you see how we make ourselves so worried about things we shouldn't be worried about?

I don't care how new you are to Christianity. If there's a sick person who's ready to have hands laid on him, go and lay your hands on him, man. God will surprise you. That would be wonderful because the Spirit of God wants to work through you just as it works through me. do you understand? And so the same Spirit works all things in all. Now there are three categories of talent. Let's make some notes here; this is important to remember. Three categories of talent are listed here.

Number one, three of them say something. Three of them say something. That's the first category. The gift of speaking. Number two, three of them do something. These are the talents that emerge in the work. Three of them say something. Three of them do something. Three of them reveal something. Three of them are advertising talents. Let us note this because you can see that God covers every aspect of human needs. Now, the three that say something are the gifts of speech. This is in verse 8.

We have the word "rather" which is in verse 10. Gifts of speech or articulation. The first is prophecy. The second is the diversity of languages. The third is the interpretation of languages. It is all written exactly there in verse 10. Prophecy, tongues, and interpretation. They are all talking. They all say something. The next category is the three that do things. These are the talents of the job. These are the gifts of power. Let's include them. The first one to do something is to have faith. The gift of faith.

Then you have the talent of creating forces. Then you have healing gifts. These are the talents that do something. Gifts of faith, gifts of powers, and gifts of healing. Now look at your Bible very carefully. I want you to look at something. You might have missed that. Look at verse nine. Underline the word talents. Note that it is a word in the plural form. People read the Bible but don't even look at what they are reading. How many times have we ourselves said that we have a gift for healing?

It is a plural word in Greek because you see that there are many kinds of healings, and it also means that God gives many different kinds of healing. You may have something wrong with your chest, and the next person may have something wrong with their head. The following person may have cancer. Another person may be suffering from rheumatism. Another person may only have diarrhea. A person may only suffer from a disease in their fingers. In other words, there are different types of healing.

There may be healing for a marriage. This is healing. This is a type of healing. There are healing gifts. Many different types. Perhaps you need healing in your emotions. Perhaps you need healing from your past. This is a completely different type of healing than physical healing. Perhaps you have psychological problems and need healing in your mind, in your thoughts, in your mental zone. Well, I'm telling you, this is a different kind of healing. This is a healing from God. God will heal you there.

But it is different from healing in the body, in the flesh. Good? So be careful how you read the Bible and take notes, because there are things God wants to say that we overlook. Good. Now, the gifts of healing come in the plural because God has different kinds of healing that He bestows. Let me make one more note here about healing. Healing works in two different ways. This is an important point. Remember this. The Lord may place the gift of healing within me. Good.

I put my hand on someone, and that person is the sick person. But do you know that the gift of healing leaves me and goes to them because I do not need healing? They are the ones who need it. So when he says gifts of healing, it is not the person who is praying for you who possesses the gift. You receive the talent yourself because you need it. Let me ask you a question. If you need a watch and I give you a watch as a gift, who owns the watch? Who needed it?

You see, it is now a gift, and it came through me, but it is a gift. It is your gift, not mine. And you needed it. So when it is said that the gifts of healing are received, it means that every sick person receives the gifts of healing. It's like giving away gifts. Now, there is a big difference between talent and results, and we will deal with that later. You have the fruits of the Spirit and the gifts of the Spirit. Good. Now, let's take a look at the other category of talent.

There are talents of speech, talents of action, and talents of revelation. Now, let's look at these detection talents. Verse 8, the word of wisdom is one of them. The word knowledge is another one. And the discernment of spirits. These are all advertising talents. Now, if you notice, God never overlooks anything. He pays attention to every detail.
